answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 5553 Country: United Kingdom Title: I want to know the meaning of my dream basically i had a dream that i saw a spider also in another dream i saw my mum cooking what does these two dream mean. Question: assalamualaikum i want to know the meaning of my dream basically i had a dream that i saw a spider also in another dream i saw my mum cooking what does these two dream mean. Answer ID: 5553 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 631/583=D) It is an indication to protection of religion and Imaan by following Shariah and observing sunnah. The religion and Imaan shall be protected ? in-sha-Allah- by adhering to the same. The mother and her children should strive to get spiritual sustenance which can be achieved by following Imaani Aamaal with following the sunnah (of the Prophet صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
